title: submission.rs: EmailSubmission/get,changes,query,queryChanges,set
description:
Implement all 5 EmailSubmission/* handlers in src/submission.rs.

## Methods to implement

### EmailSubmission/get (RFC 8621 §7.1)
- Fetch submission objects: id, identityId, emailId, threadId, envelope, sendAt, undoStatus, deliveryStatus, dsnBlobIds, mdnBlobIds

### EmailSubmission/changes (RFC 8621 §7.2)
- Return created/updated/destroyed since sinceState

### EmailSubmission/query (RFC 8621 §7.3)
- FilterCondition: identityIds, emailIds, threadIds, undoStatus, before, after
- Sort: emailId, threadId, sentAt

### EmailSubmission/queryChanges (RFC 8621 §7.4)
- removed + added since sinceState

### EmailSubmission/set (RFC 8621 §7.5)
- create: triggers email sending
  - emailId must reference existing Email
  - identityId must reference existing Identity
  - envelope (RFC 5321): from, rcptTo list — defaults derived from email headers if omitted
  - sendAt: scheduled time (null = immediate)
  - MemoryBackend: mark as sent immediately; deliveryStatus = {delivered: yes}
- update: only undoStatus can be updated (cancel pending send); if already sent → cannotUnsend error
- destroy: only pending submissions; sent → alreadySent error
- onSuccessUpdateEmail: after submission set succeeds, also update the email (e.g. remove \Draft, add \Seen)

## Key notes
- onSuccessUpdateEmail is a companion operation processed atomically with the submission set
- MemoryBackend does NOT actually send email — just records the submission as sent

- Stalwart (AGPL — read, do not copy): ~/GIT/stalwart-jmap-server/main/crates/jmap/src/submission/

## Test vectors
- Create submission → undoStatus=final, deliveryStatus shows delivered
- Create submission with bad emailId → notCreated error
- Update submission undoStatus after sent → cannotUnsend error
